She said, “The glory has departed from Israel; for God’s ark has been taken.”
Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
All that pass by clap their hands at you. They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, “Is this…
Behold, the days come that I will cut off your arm and the arm of your father’s house, that there will not be an old…
You will see the affliction of my habitation, in all the wealth which I will give Israel. There shall not be an old man…
In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from the beginning even to the end.

For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

“If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: When he made mention of God’s ark, Eli fell from off his seat backward by the side of the gate; and his neck broke, and he died, for he was an old man and heavy. He had judged Israel forty years.
translations.bsb: As soon as the ark of God was mentioned, Eli fell backward from his chair by the city gate, and being old and heavy, he broke his neck and died. And Eli had judged Israel forty years.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when he made mention of the ark of God, that he fell from off the seat backward by the side of the gate, and his neck brake, and he died: for he was an old man, and heavy. And he had judged Israel forty years.
